title: Modular power
prompt: Print the remainder of 3^200 (3 to the power 200) divided by 1000007. Compute it with a loop that multiplies the running value by 3 step by step and reduces it modulo 1000007 after every multiplication, so that no intermediate value exceeds 3 * 1000007; do not use a built-in power or modular-exponentiation function. Print only the remainder, on one line.
